paite: Unaute aw, khamite kiang a gen bang in na kiang uah thu ka gen thei kei hi; sa mite, Khrist a naungekte kiang a gen bang in ka gen zaw hi.
heading: Saptuam Sung A Kipawlkhenna

paite: An gum na nek theih nai louh ziak un, nawitui in ka hon vak a, sami na hih lai ziak un tua an gum tu tanpha in leng na ne thei nai kei lailai uhi.
Na lak ua kihazatna leh kiselna a-om nak ziak in sami hi lai in mihing bang a om lai hilou na hi uhiam?
Mi khat in, “Paul pawl ka hi," midang in, “Kei zaw Apollos pawl ka hi," na chih lai teng uh mihing lel hi lai hilou na hi uhiam?
Apollos kua ahia le? Paul leng kua ahia? Nasemmi, noumau hon gingtasak mi lel ahi ve ua, huai leng Toupa'n apiak bang zel in ahi.
Ke'n ka suan a, Apollos in tui in avak a, himahleh Pathian in akhangsak hi.
Huchi in akhangsakpa Pathian kia lou ngal, asuanpa lah bangmah ahi kei a, tui a vakpa leng bangmah ahi tuan kei hi.
Huan asuanpa leh tui a vakpa pum khat ahi ua, himahleh amau sepgim bang zel in, amau kipahman amu tuaktuak ding uhi.
Koute Pathian na seppihte ka hi ua, noute Pathian louma na hi ua, Pathian inn lam leng na hi uhi.
Pathian in hehpihna hon piak bang zel in inn lam heutupen piltak bang in ke'n suangphum ka lem a, midang in atung ah inn alam uhi. Himahleh michih atung a alamdan ding uah pilvang uhen.
heading: Michih Nasep Ettelna

paite: Suangphum lepkhitsa lou ngal suangphum dang kuamah in alem theita kei ua, huai suangphum Jesu Khrist ahi.
Hiai suangphum tung ah kuapeuh in dangka-eng in hiam, dangka in hiam, suangmantam in hiam, sing in hiam, loupa in hiam, buhpawl hiam zang in lam taleh;
michih nasep ahong lang ding hi; tua Ni in hihlang ding ahi ngal a, meikuang a akilak ding ziak in; meikuang ngeingei in michih nasep bangchibang ahia chih a-enchian ding hi.
Kua nasep leng atung a alam pen a-om gigeleh huai mi in kipahman amu ding.
Kua nasep leng akatleh huai mi in atan ding hi; amah taktak zaw hotdam in a-om ding, himahleh mei apaisuak bang in.
Pathian tempul na hih uleh Pathian Kha noumau sung ah ateng gige chih na thei kei ua hia?
Kuapeuh in Pathian tempul ahihsiatleh Pathian in huai mi ahihse ding; Pathian tempul asiangthou ngal a, huai tempul noumau na hi uhi.
Kuamah amah-le-amah kikhem kei hen. Na lak ua kuapeuh hiai khovel a pil akisakleh, ahong piltheihna ding in mihai hong suak hen.
Hiai khovel pilna Pathian ngaihdan in haina ahi. "Ama'n amaute apil lepchiahna uah aman hi," chih gelh ahi;
Toupa'n mipilte ngaihtuahna athawn ahi, chih athei chi a gelh ahi nawn lai hi.
Huaiziak in kuamah in mihingte suang kei hen; bangkim nou a ahi vekta ngal a;
Paul hiam, Apollos hiam, Kifas hiam, khovel hiam, hinna hiam, sihna hiam, thil omsa hiam, thil hong om ding hiam;
avek in nou a ahi vek hi; noumau leng Khrist a na hi ua; Khrist leng Pathian a ahi.
